mir.text: Teferi, the court mage of Zhalfir, had unified the houses into guilds to serve Zhalfir above their own interests.
His time experiments went wrong and his phasing energy burst made every plant, animal and building on his isle phase out of existence, until the isle returned and he reawakened.
When Kaervek attacked the isle, Jolrael ambushed him and Teferi sank his fleet, and Teferi also sent visions to Jamuraa that led Asmira to recover the imprisoned Mangara.
Later, to spare the land from the Phyrexian Invasion, Teferi phased out Zhalfir entirely, opening the Zhalfir rift, and when it was sealed Zhalfir was lost to Dominaria for good.

vis.text: When his isle returned he slew one of Jolrael's dragons, and although she sought his help he refused to intercede and offered only dreams and visions.
Then Kaervek sailed to the isle, where Teferi destroyed his armada and Jolrael turned on him.

usg.text: Teferi began as a student at the Tolarian Academy, where Barrin's progress report called him a problem student.
He made Teferi's Drakes there, and Barrin used them to defend the university against Kerrick's forces.

Kerrick's infiltration caused the Tolarian Temporal Disaster, which destroyed most of the Academy, and Teferi was left trapped in a slow-time bubble until Jhoira's machine and the returning Urza, Barrin and Karn pulled him free.
Once rescued, Teferi helped Barrin, Jhoira and their allies end the Invasion of Tolaria, and he went on to work toward ending Zhalfir's civil war.

pcy.text: After the Phyrexian war, Teferi phased out Zhalfir to save it from further strife.
He and Barrin defeated Latulla's banished followers in Jamuraa, and Teferi sent Barrin to reorganize the League.
In the end an embittered Barrin and a shaken Teferi turned away from Urza's plan.

tsp.text: Teferi had phased Zhalfir and Shiv out of the timestream to protect them during the Phyrexian Invasion, tearing localized rifts as he did so.
Returning from his phased-out home, he realized the connection between land and mana was breaking and sought help, but Freyalise refused, angry over his abandonment of Dominaria during the Invasion.
He found Radha, who agreed to join him in exchange for ancient Keldon knowledge, and Venser, and Teferi sensed that both had planeswalker sparks different from his own.
Teferi challenged Nicol Bolas to a duel and was easily defeated, though he convinced Bolas of the rifts' dangers.
In the end, helped by Jhoira, Teferi channeled all his life force into the Shivan rift; Shiv phased in safely, but Teferi lost his spark and became mortal.

tsb.text: On this set's card, Teferi is a person to whom Urza says isolation is not the answer.

dom.text: Teferi had lived as a mortal in the years after he gave up his spark, and he wed the caravan leader Subira and they had a daughter, Niambi.
Returning to Urza's monument with Niambi, he explained that he phased Zhalfir out to protect it from the Phyrexians, and Jhoira revealed she held his planeswalker spark in a powerstone.
When Subira's caravan was threatened by a sandstorm, he stretched a time bubble to deflect it, then learned that Kwende had framed him, and Teferi said he would restore Zhalfir if he could.
Jhoira dropped the pendant into his palm and Teferi took back his spark, joining the Gatewatch against Bolas.

mh1.text: On this set's card, Teferi is a planeswalker who says he has no time for you right now.

m21.text: On this set's card, Teferi's spark crystal pulsed with power, and his legacy lives on in Tolaria.

mid.text: On Innistrad, Teferi joined Chandra, Kaya and Arlinn when Arlinn asked the Gatewatch for help finding the Moonsilver Key.
He met Wrenn, who gave him insight into metamagic so he could see and undo his corrupted time spell, leaving them trapped in a time loop that he later undid.
Teferi helped Arlinn recover the key from the Markov catacombs while Sigarda and Sorin battled.

When Tovolar attacked the Harvesttide festival, Teferi delayed the sunset to stall the werewolves' transformation, but his spell ended, the sun set and all the werewolves transformed, including Arlinn.

vow.text: Teferi joined cathars searching for a white witch as an excuse to leave an inn, and in the woods he found Wrenn speaking to an oak.
After Wrenn lent her natural magic, Teferi unmade the tangled time spell and restored the path, and he confided that he had lost the continent of Zhalfir through a similar spell.
Back among his friends, Teferi, Kaya and Chandra agreed to help Arlinn and traveled with her to Katilda's coven.
At the ruined Thraben cathedral he slowed the undead while Adeline's cathars charged, then found the Moonsilver Key in the hands of a headless statue of Avacyn.

At Harvesttide he planted his staff and slowed time to hold back the sunset, and once the key was recovered and balance restored, Teferi borrowed the Moonsilver Key and warned Arlinn about Phyrexians.

dmu.text: Teferi arrived at the Oyster Bay peace summit with Karn to reveal the Phyrexian threat, and Benalish knights were exposed as sleeper agents.
Locked in the watchtower with the group, Teferi apologized to Karn for how Urza had treated him, and Karn told him where he had hidden the sylex.
Teferi was pinned and gutted by a Phyrexian monstrosity and Raff healed his grave wound, after which Teferi served as the New Coalition's general and proposed to Darigaaz that they fight at Shiv.
With Saheeli and Kaya he installed the Temporal Anchor at Urza's Tower to learn how the Sylex works, but his first three attempts landed in the wrong eras.
At last he witnessed Urza setting the Sylex Blast and learned that the trigger was a person, but the powerstone imploded and left Teferi's consciousness lost in the time stream.

bro.text: Teferi brought Karn a captured Phyrexian saboteur and apologized for treating him as a thing, and Karn accepted.
With Jodah and Jhoira, Teferi built a monument to Jaya in Shiv's desert and left an empty pyramid for Karn, and then he resolved to cross time itself to learn how to activate the sylex.
Before leaving, he confessed to Wrenn how he took Zhalfir away from Urza's war, and told Elspeth about Ajani's compleation and that everything he does is about saving his daughter Niambi.
Teferi found the Last Battle on Argoth moments before the sylex detonated, and in a void he told the burned Urza about the Phyrexians and learned that the trigger was a person.
Kaya could not pull his spirit back before the Temporal Anchor failed, and Teferi was set adrift in time.

one.text: Teferi woke on a beach, cut off from Kaya and unable to planeswalk, and he realized he was back in Zhalfir nearly four hundred years earlier.

A caravan's guards held him at spearpoint, and Eshe named him the snake who escaped Zhalfir's suffering and thrust her spear at his heart, so he froze time and told her about Subira and his guilt for sending Zhalfir away.
Teferi vowed to see Zhalfir safe through what comes next, and months later was reunited with the general Jabari, who brought him to the queen.
He decided to stand with Zhalfir, and when the Wanderer warned that New Phyrexia's invasion was upon them, he resolved that it was not too late.
Wrenn then opened a portal summoning Teferi and the Zhalfiran army, and they turned the tide against the Phyrexians.

mom.text: Wrenn and Eight traced Teferi's magic to a hidden place out of time, where Wrenn asked him to come to New Phyrexia to help the losing fight.
Teferi led Zhalfir's warriors across the portal, ready for war after many years.
On the field he told Koth that the two planes were swapping places, stopped the blades of Jin-Gitaxias's war machine, and called the retreat as the Mirrans passed through the portal.
Afterward he found an acorn in the ashen remains of Wrenn and planted it on a grassy hill as a tribute to her, and he stopped time in a bubble so Melira and Karn could cleanse Nissa and Ajani.
Teferi's spark faded in the Great Desparkening.

mat.text: In Zhalfir, Nissa learned that Teferi's and Koth's sparks had faded too.
When Nissa failed to summon an elemental and was thrown by the beast, Teferi froze it with his blue spell and Karn held it.
Teferi Akosa also joined Karn, Kaya, Koth and Melira in the ritual to un-compleat Ajani and Nissa, in which Melira died and Karn lost his spark.

fdn.text: Teferi resolves to risk everything to fix his mistakes.
